why: Both manometer arms join the flowing water (figure), so water stands above the mercury on each side: dP = h(rho_Hg - rho_w)g, not h rho_Hg g. h = 21/(2 x 9.8 x 12.6) = 0.0850 m = 8.50 cm, not the book's 7.878 cm.
find:
\(\Delta P = \dfrac{1}{2}\rho_w(v_2^2 - v_1^2) = h\rho_{Hg}g\)
\(\therefore h = \dfrac{(v_2^2 - v_1^2)}{2g\left(\dfrac{\rho_{Hg}}{\rho_w}\right)} = \dfrac{25 - 4}{2 \times 9.8 \times 13.6} = 0.07878\) m
\(= 7.878\) cm
replace:
\(\Delta P = \dfrac{1}{2}\rho_w(v_2^2 - v_1^2) = h(\rho_{Hg} - \rho_w)g\)
\(\therefore h = \dfrac{(v_2^2 - v_1^2)}{2g\left(\dfrac{\rho_{Hg}}{\rho_w} - 1\right)} = \dfrac{25 - 4}{2 \times 9.8 \times 12.6} = 0.0850\) m
\(= 8.50\) cm
